{"summary":"Users report severe performance degradation after the latest update, with phones freezing and rebooting frequently. [#tk_704578]
Many complain that basic functions like texting, calling, and app launches are delayed or fail entirely. [#tk_2786453]
The update also causes random shutdowns, screen lockouts, and loss of contacts, eroding user trust. [#tk_1835043]
Users fear critical failures during emergencies, citing concerns about phone reliability for 911 calls. [#tk_2873394]
Overall sentiment is overwhelmingly negative, with 96% of feedback expressing dissatisfaction and calls for a fix. [#tk_550805]"}
